item.title: Padres minor league coach freed from ICE custody, family confirms
item.description: A Padres minor league coaching coordinator detained by federal immigration officers in Texas has been released on bond, according to his family.

item.title: Court orders release of another witness in fatal shooting by immigration agent
item.description: A second witness to a fatal shooting in Houston by a federal immigration agent has been ordered released after over a month in custody.

item.title: Padres minor league coach freed from ICE detention
item.description: A San Diego Padres minor league coaching coordinator detained by immigration officers in Texas has been released on bond, his family says.

item.title: Democrats file new legal challenge to Trump postal service election plans
item.description: Congressional Democrats and voting rights advocates filed new challenges Tuesday to President Trump's plans for the post office to oversee this year's election.
